issues.location: bullet list, “Truncation/treatment of extended text chunks”
issues.problem: “긴 텍스트 조각의 절단과 처리” is understandable but slightly stiff; “절단” feels like a mechanical calque in this technical context.
issues.suggestion: Consider a more natural phrasing such as “긴 텍스트 조각을 잘라 다루기” or “긴 텍스트 청크 처리 방식” if revising.

reviews.notes: The Korean reads as a native technical essay rather than a sentence-by-sentence transfer: it reshapes long English clauses into natural Korean rhythm, preserves the author’s blunt casual tone, and translates reader-facing captions, alt text, links, and attribution appropriately while keeping product names and technical terms intact.

issues.problem: "stateless design" is translated as "상태 없는 설계". It is understandable, but the more idiomatic Korean technical term is "무상태 설계".
issues.suggestion: Use "Firestore와 FastAPI를 바탕으로 한 무상태 설계" if polishing manually.

issues.problem: "not the most reliable cookie in the world" becomes "세상에서 제일 믿음직한 물건은 아니다," which preserves meaning but softens the oddball idiom and some of the author's comic texture.
issues.suggestion: A slightly more voiced rendering such as "세상에서 제일 믿음직한 녀석은 아니다" would better preserve the casual humor.
